data.name: No Serial
data.detailed_description:
You start with a small backroom operation and slowly build it into something bigger. Accept jobs, gather materials, use your workstations, prepare the requested weapons, and deliver them to the right people. Some orders are simple. Others are riskier, pay more, and bring more attention.

Craft Weapons

Use different workstations to craft and prepare weapons for clients. Each order requires the right materials, tools, and steps before it is ready to sell.

Take Orders and Make Sales

Clients will request different weapons depending on their needs. Complete the order, deliver the item, and get paid. As your reputation grows, better clients and riskier deals become available.

Upgrade Your Operation

Use the money you earn to improve your workshop, unlock better tools, expand your setup, and handle more valuable orders.

Avoid Getting Caught

The more your business grows, the more attention it brings. Manage your risk, be careful with deals, and try to keep the operation running without drawing too much heat.

Grow From a Small Workshop

No Serial is about building something illegal from the ground up — not as a hero, not as a mastermind, but as someone trying to turn a hidden workshop into a serious business without losing control of it.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-8350 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8192 MB MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Temporary requirements. May change during Early Access as optimization improves.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600 or better
  • Memory: 16384 MB MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for smoother performance at higher settings. Requirements may change during development.
